Idle.description: The pipeline is at its initial waiting boundary and remains inactive until a new quality engineering run is started.

Fetching ticket.description: The pipeline retrieves and verifies the work ticket that defines the scope and acceptance criteria for the quality engineering run.

Failed.description: The quality engineering pipeline terminated unsuccessfully because of an unrecoverable failure or an explicit cancellation from any non-terminal stage.

Detecting mode.description: The pipeline determines the execution mode and testing strategy required by the fetched ticket and its repository or environment.

Analysing.description: The pipeline analyses the requested change, relevant risks, existing coverage, and technical constraints before creating a test plan.

Planning.description: The pipeline creates an actionable quality plan covering test scope, validation criteria, execution order, and expected evidence.

Awaiting approval.description: The pipeline is paused at a human approval gate and cannot continue until an authorized human explicitly approves the quality plan.

Preparing test data.description: The pipeline prepares deterministic fixtures, datasets, mocks, credentials, and environment inputs required for test generation and execution.

Generating.description: The pipeline generates the planned tests, checks, configuration, and supporting artifacts needed to validate the requested change.

Validating.description: The pipeline validates the generated artifacts for correctness, completeness, consistency with the plan, and readiness for runtime execution.

Runtime validation.description: The pipeline runs the generated quality checks against the target runtime and evaluates observed results against the defined acceptance criteria.

Reporting.description: The pipeline consolidates execution results, validation evidence, diagnostics, and quality conclusions into the final engineering report.

Done.description: The quality engineering pipeline completed successfully, and its final report and validation evidence are available to downstream stakeholders.
